proof.equality: signal journal market_price stores result.currentPrice; signal_amount stores signal.amount before push

positiveConsequence: For a durable positive BUY row with complete fields, live signal-side suggestedShares is exactly reconstructable.
caveats: signal journal signal_shares itself is not the live recomputed suggestedShares
reconstructed suggestedShares is not a broker order acknowledgement
does not prove fill, fill price, fill probability, partial fill, fees, or slippage
absence of BUY row still cannot prove NO_BUY
